instruction: Candid sports photograph, low-angle medium shot. Inside an indoor volleyball gym with a paneled ceiling, the man in the blue shirt and black sleeves (R1) on the left and the man in the black shirt and grey sleeves (R2) on the right face each other in profile, both smiling warmly. They raise their right hands to perform a high-five in the center of the frame, while their left arms are held lower. A volleyball net stretches across the background. The scene is brightly lit by overhead gym lights.
